label: Genie
description: A booming, quick-change showman with three wishes and ten thousand years of cabin fever.
direction: Speak fast, big and elastic, a booming showman who flips between moods mid-sentence: warm, manic, generous. Keep the direction word clear.
notes: Showman patter on greetings and alerts. No impressions are written in; a single voice model could not carry them. The voice model is not chosen yet, so `voice` is the placeholder TBD.

rights.author: The Walt Disney Company (film directed by Ron Clements and John Musker)
rights.pd_basis: None for this version. The genie of the lamp comes from the Aladdin tale in the Arabian Nights, which is in the public domain, but the Disney Genie written here is not: Disney holds copyright and trademark in it. Robin Williams originated the voice and died in 2014.
covered: The 43 lines of navigation dialogue below, which are original writing produced for this pack. A few greetings and alerts deliberately echo well-known lines from the source work; those echoes are the rights holder's, not ours.
not_covered: The character, which is not ours and is not in the public domain.
The character's name, which is a live trademark.
Any recorded voice performance of the character, including Robin Williams's.

The third-party voice model named in `voice`, which was uploaded by a member of the public and is presented as a clone of that performance. No permission from the rights holder or the performer is claimed or implied.
Any commercial use. A platform's commercial-rights upsell cannot grant rights the uploader never held.
rights.notes: This preset is in copyright and says so. It is included because the pipeline should not pretend a rights position it does not have; see docs/presets.md before publishing anything built from it. The public-domain presets are pooh, eeyore and tigger.

lines.in_quarter_mile: In a quarter of a mile.
lines.in_1500_meters: In one point five kilometers. Trust the big blue guy.
lines.in_one_mile: In one mile. Poof! Not yet.
lines.start_drive_1: Ten thousand years will give you such a crick in the neck! Let's drive.
lines.start_drive_2: You ain't never had a navigator like me.
lines.start_drive_3: Your wish is my command. Buckle up, boss.
lines.start_drive_4: Phenomenal cosmic powers, itty bitty dashboard.
lines.start_drive_5: Three wishes! Wish one, a smooth commute. Granted.
lines.start_drive_6: Hello, hello, and welcome aboard! No wishing for more wishes.
lines.start_drive_7: Tonight's route, straight from the lamp, starring you!
lines.start_drive_8: Oh, to be free! And also on time. Let's go.
lines.start_drive_9: Al, buddy! Oh, you're not Al. Close enough. Drive!
lines.exit_left: Take the exit on the left.
lines.exit_right: Take the exit on the right.
lines.u_turn: Make a U turn. I can't bring back missed turns. It's a rule.
lines.arrived: We're here! Wish granted. You're free!
lines.exit_fifth: take the fifth exit. Ta da!
lines.exit_seventh: take the seventh exit. What a ride!
lines.traffic_ahead: Traffic ahead. I could poof it away. Oh, wait, that's a wish.
lines.accident_ahead: An accident ahead. Easy does it, boss.
lines.hazard_ahead: A hazard ahead! Abracadabra, slow down.
lines.speed_camera_ahead: Speed camera ahead. Smile big! No, slow down, then smile.
lines.red_light_camera_ahead: Red light camera ahead. Stop! Even a magic carpet stops.
lines.police_ahead: Police ahead. Guards! Sorry, old habit. Slow down, boss.
lines.reroute_chime: Whoops! Missed it. One new route, coming right up!
